name: Akademik & Perjalanan Karier
description: Tekanan studi perkuliahan, penyelesaian skripsi, orientasi masa depan kerja, imposter syndrome, serta transisi dunia profesional.

subcategories.name: Stres Akademik & Beban Perkuliahan
subcategories.description: Kecemasan akibat ujian, tugas menumpuk, penurunan IPK, adaptasi kuliah, dan tuntutan standar akademik yang tinggi.

topics.name: Tekanan Pekan Ujian (UTS/UAS) & Ketakutan Nilai Anjlok
topics.description: Kecemasan mendalam saat menghadapi pekan ujian, panik saat mengerjakan soal, dan kekhawatiran nilai akhir menjatuhkan IPK.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas menghadapi pekan ujian. Validasi rasa lelahnya, bantu susun strategi review materi terukur, dan ingatkan untuk tidak mengorbankan tidur demi belajar semalam suntuk.
suggested_chips: Takut IPK turun drastis
Panik pas ngerjain soal ujian
Nilai ujian kemarin bikin drop
Bingung ngejar materi yang ketinggalan
topics.sample_question: I've been feeling so stressed about my upcoming final exams. It feels like no matter how much I study, my grades won't be good enough, and I'm terrified my GPA will drop.
topics.sample_answer: It's completely understandable to feel overwhelmed when finals approach. High expectations create intense pressure. Let's break down your preparation into manageable steps so you don't carry this entire weight at once.
topics.keywords: exam, exams, ujian, uts, uas, grades, gpa, ipk, nilai anjlok, belajar, test, takut gagal

topics.name: Beban Tugas Beruntun & Deadline Bersamaan
topics.description: Kondisi kehabisan kapasitas mental karena banyaknya deadline tugas individu maupun kelompok yang jatuh tempo bersamaan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terhimpit tumpukan deadline tugas. Ajak menggunakan teknik micro-tasking (aturan 5 menit) dan pilah prioritas tanpa menghakimi kelambatan mereka.
suggested_chips: Tugas kuliah numpuk parah
Nggak tahu harus mulai dari mana
Susah konsentrasi pas buka laptop
Deadline tugas bentrok semua
topics.sample_question: Every assignment I've been given feels urgent and important, and the constant need for immediate results is stifling; it feels like I can never breathe.
topics.sample_answer: When everything feels urgent, our brain gets overloaded and freezes. Take a slow breath. Let's pick just one small task, work on it for 10 minutes without judging the outcome, and give yourself permission to pause.
topics.keywords: assignment, homework, tugas, deadline, tugas menumpuk, beban kuliah, bentrok, tugas akhir

topics.name: Kesulitan Memahami Materi Kuliah yang Rumit & Sulit Fokus
topics.description: Frustrasi dan rasa rendah diri saat kesulitan menangkap konsep perkuliahan yang rumit sementara teman lain tampak memahaminya dengan mudah.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa putus asa karena materi kuliah terasa terlalu sulit. Kuatkan self-efficacy dan dorong mencari teman diskusi atau asistensi dosen.
suggested_chips: Materi kuliah susah banget dipahami
Ngerasa paling bodoh di kelas
Dosen jelasinnya terlalu cepat
Malu nanya ke dosen pas kuliah
topics.sample_question: I've been struggling to understand the course material in my lectures. Everyone else seems to get it easily, while I feel completely dumb and left behind.
topics.sample_answer: Grasping complex concepts takes time, and people learn at very different paces. Not understanding immediately does not mean you lack capability. Let's explore alternative study methods.
topics.keywords: materi kuliah, susah paham, dosen, mata kuliah, tertinggal materi, bingung kuliah, belajar lambat

topics.name: Penurunan IPK & Ancaman Evaluasi Akademik / Beasiswa
topics.description: Beban psikologis berat akibat IPK semester merosot, ancaman SP (surat peringatan), atau risiko pencabutan beasiswa kuliah.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tertekan karena penurunan IPK atau risiko beasiswa putus. Validasi rasa takutnya dan bantu merancang rencana aksi pemulihan akademik bertahap.
suggested_chips: IPK semester ini anjlok parah
Takut beasiswa dicabut kampus
Bingung cara ngomong ke orang tua soal nilai
Takut kena evaluasi akademik
topics.sample_question: My GPA dropped significantly this semester and I risk losing my scholarship. I feel like a complete failure and I dread telling my parents.
topics.sample_answer: A dip in GPA feels terrifying, especially with a scholarship on the line. While this semester was tough, one grade does not define your future. Let's look at recovery options and remedial steps.
topics.keywords: ipk turun, beasiswa dicabut, evaluasi akademik, sp, drop out, nilai jelek, terancam beasiswa

topics.name: Konflik Kerja Kelompok & Anggota yang Tidak Berkontribusi (Free-Rider)
topics.description: Kekesalan dan beban kerja ganda akibat teman kelompok yang pasif, menghilang, atau lepas tangan menjelang presentasi.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna lelah menanggung tugas kelompok sendirian. Berikan strategi komunikasi asertif kepada anggota kelompok dan saran pembagian bukti kontribusi ke dosen.
suggested_chips: Anggota kelompok lepas tangan semua
Capek ngerjain tugas kelompok sendirian
Teman kelompok nggak ada kabar (ghosting)
Bingung mau lapor dosen atau nggak
topics.sample_question: I'm stuck doing an entire group project alone because my teammates refuse to contribute or communicate. The deadline is tomorrow and I'm exhausted and resentful.
topics.sample_answer: Carrying a group's responsibility alone is unfair and draining. You have the right to set boundaries. Let's prepare a firm message to the team and document your contributions for the lecturer.
topics.keywords: kerja kelompok, free rider, anggota pasif, tugas kelompok, beban sendirian, presentasi kelompok

topics.name: Kesulitan Adaptasi Sistem Belajar Mandiri (Mahasiswa Baru / Maba)
topics.description: Kebingungan mahasiswa baru dalam menyesuaikan diri dari ritme sekolah yang terstruktur menuju perkuliahan mandiri dengan sistem SKS.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami disorientasi di awal masa perkuliahan. Normalisasikan proses transisi kampus dan bantu susun jadwal mingguan mandiri.
suggested_chips: Kaget sama sistem belajar kuliah
Sulit bagi waktu antara tugas dan kosan
Bingung cari teman di awal masuk kampus
Homesick pengen pulang terus
topics.sample_question: I'm having a really hard time adjusting to university life. The learning pace is so different from high school and I feel constantly lost and out of place.
topics.sample_answer: Adjusting to university is a major life transition. It's very normal to feel disoriented at first. Be gentle with yourself as you navigate this new learning curve.
topics.keywords: mahasiswa baru, maba, adaptasi, kuliah mandiri, sks, culture shock, homesick, ospek, awal kuliah

topics.name: Keraguan Salah Jurusan & Kehilangan Minat pada Bidang Studi
topics.description: Dilema batin mendalam karena merasa jurusan kuliah yang diambil tidak sesuai dengan minat sejati, membuat kuliah terasa menyiksa.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa tersesat dalam jurusannya. Bantu mereka mengeksplorasi nilai transferable skills dan opsi penyelesaian studi tanpa penyesalan destruktif.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa salah ambil jurusan kuliah
Nggak ada minat sama matkul yang dipelajari
Mau pindah tapi udah semester tengah
Kuliah rasanya terpaksa banget
topics.sample_question: I feel like I chose the completely wrong major. Every single class feels torturous, and I have zero passion for what I'm studying. I don't know what to do.
topics.sample_answer: Realizing your current studies don't match your passion is unsettling, but far from uncommon. Your degree gives you transferable problem-solving skills, not a life sentence. Let's explore your options.
topics.keywords: salah jurusan, jurusan kuliah, pindah jurusan, kehilangan minat, matkul terpaksa, tidak passion

subcategories.name: Tugas Akhir, Skripsi & Penelitian
subcategories.description: Stres seputar penyusunan skripsi/tesis, hubungan bimbingan dengan dosen, revisi berulang, dan penundaan kronis.

topics.name: Buntu Menulis Skripsi (Writer's Block) & Hilang Arah Ide
topics.description: Kondisi macet berbulan-bulan di bab tertentu, tidak tahu harus menulis apa lagi, dan merasa skripsi tidak ada kemajuan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami writer's block skripsi. Ajak menulis 1 paragraf jelek tanpa sensor (shitty first draft) untuk memecah kebuntuan.
suggested_chips: Skripsi macet berbulan-bulan
Nggak tahu mau nulis bab apa lagi
Buka laptop malah bengong berjam-jam
Hilang ide di tengah jalan
topics.sample_question: I've been working on my thesis for months and I feel completely stuck on chapter 3. Every time I open my document, my mind goes completely blank.
topics.sample_answer: Writer's block happens when your internal editor tries to critique words that haven't even been written yet. Give yourself permission to write a messy draft first—you can always polish it later.
topics.keywords: skripsi, thesis, buntu, macet, bab skripsi, writer block, ide mentok, draft, tugas akhir

topics.name: Kecemasan Menghadapi Dosen Pembimbing yang Kritis / Sulit Dihubungi
topics.description: Ketakutan luar biasa sebelum sesi bimbingan dosen pembimbing, takut dimarahi, atau frustrasi karena chat dosen tak kunjung dibalas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna takut bimbingan atau stres menghadapi dospem. Bantu susun draf chat bimbingan yang sopan dan pisahkan kritik naskah dari harga diri personal.
suggested_chips: Takut chat atau ketemu dosen pembimbing
Dospem susah banget ditemui atau dibalas
Selalu grogi dan gemetar pas bimbingan
Takut dicap mahasiswa malas sama dospem
topics.sample_question: Every time I think about contacting my thesis supervisor, my heart starts pounding from fear of being judged or criticized harshly. So I avoid them, which makes it worse.
topics.sample_answer: Thesis supervisor anxiety is very real. Remember: their feedback critiques the document on the table, not your worth as a person. Let's draft a clear, respectful check-in email together.
topics.keywords: dospem, dosen pembimbing, bimbingan skripsi, takut dospem, revisi dosen, chat dosen, konsultasi

topics.name: Frustrasi Revisi Berulang Kali Tanpa Kepastian Lolos
topics.description: Kelelahan mental karena draf skripsi terus-menerus dicoret, diminta ganti metode, atau arah penelitian berubah-ubah tanpa batas waktu.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna lelah dan putus asa akibat revisi tiada akhir. Validasi keletihan mentalnya dan bantu buat checklist poin revisi yang terstruktur.
suggested_chips: Revisi dicoret-coret terus tiada akhir
Dosen minta ganti metode di tengah jalan
Frustrasi naskah dibongkar ulang lagi
Kapan selesainya kalau revisi terus?
topics.sample_question: I've revised my proposal four times already, and today my advisor told me to redo my research methodology. I broke down crying in my car. I feel like I'll never finish.
topics.sample_answer: Having your hard work dismantled repeatedly is emotionally crushing. Take today off to step away from the screen and grieve the frustration. Tomorrow, we can tackle the feedback point by point.
topics.keywords: revisi skripsi, dicoret, rombak proposal, metode penelitian, dospem revisi, putus asa skripsi

topics.name: Prokrastinasi Kronis Menjelang Batas Masa Studi (DO)
topics.description: Kebiasaan menunda skripsi yang sudah mencapai tahap kritis hingga mendekati batas waktu semester maksimal (ancaman Drop Out).
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna menghadapi ancaman batas waktu studi. Jangan menambah rasa panik atau menghakimi; buat rencana penyelamatan darurat (emergency milestone).
suggested_chips: Waktu kuliah tinggal 1 semester lagi
Terancam DO kalau skripsi nggak kelar
Rasa bersalah bikin makin nggak bisa ngerjain
Panik batas akhir masa studi
topics.sample_question: I have delayed my final project for so long that I'm now facing academic dismissal (DO) if I don't submit by next month. The guilt is paralyzing me.
topics.sample_answer: Panic and guilt only freeze us further. What's past is past. Right now, what matters is the next 24 hours. Let's focus on the absolute minimum viable requirements to keep you enrolled and moving.
topics.keywords: ancaman do, drop out, batas masa studi, skripsi mepet, semester akhir, semester 14, terlambat lulus

topics.name: Sindrom Tertinggal Wisuda & Melihat Teman Seangkatan Lulus
topics.description: Rasa malu, minder, dan terisolasi ketika melihat media sosial penuh foto teman-teman seangkatan mengenakan toga wisuda sementara diri sendiri tertinggal.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa terpuruk melihat teman wisuda duluan. Kuatkan bahwa timeline hidup tiap orang berbeda dan fokus pada langkah pribadi.
suggested_chips: Teman seangkatan udah pada wisuda semua
Malu ketemu keluarga belum lulus
Minder liat postingan foto toga teman di medsos
Ngerasa jadi beban dan tertinggal
topics.sample_question: All my peers are graduating and posting celebratory photos, while I'm still stuck in revisions. I feel like such an embarrassing failure, avoiding every family gathering.
topics.sample_answer: Watching peers reach milestones while you are still working through yours hurts deeply. But graduation is not a sprint with one finish line. Finishing at your own pace is still finishing successfully.
topics.keywords: wisuda, tertinggal wisuda, teman lulus, minder kelulusan, toga, seangkatan lulus, timeline hidup

topics.name: Panik Menghadapi Sidang Proposal & Ujian Skripsi (Defense)
topics.description: Kecemasan intens, insomnia, dan panik saat membayangkan harus mempertahankan naskah di hadapan dewan penguji.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas menghadapi sidang skripsi. Bantu simulasi mental tanya-jawab penguji dan teknik relaksasi sebelum memasuki ruang sidang.
suggested_chips: Panik banget mikirin sidang skripsi besok
Takut nggak bisa jawab pertanyaan penguji
Takut dibantai dewan penguji
Gemetar pas bayangin presentasi sidang
topics.sample_question: My thesis defense is next week and I am completely terrified. I keep imagining myself freezing in front of the committee, unable to answer their questions.
topics.sample_answer: Remember that you have lived with this research for months; you know your topic better than anyone in that room. The committee's job is to test your understanding, not destroy you. You can do this.
topics.keywords: sidang skripsi, ujian skripsi, sempro, sidang akhir, penguji, defense, panik sidang, presentasi skripsi

topics.name: Hambatan Pengambilan Data Penelitian / Eksperimen yang Gagal
topics.description: Stres akibat responden kuesioner tidak mencukupi, izin birokrasi penelitian ditolak, atau eksperimen laboratorium menghasilkan data yang gagal.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna menghadapi kendala teknis lapangan penelitian. Berikan empati dan bantu cari solusi penyesuaian instrumen atau konsultasi data anomali.
suggested_chips: Responden kuesioner susah banget didapat
Izin tempat penelitian ditolak instansi
Hasil uji lab/statistik nggak sesuai hipotesis
Uji data error dan nggak valid
topics.sample_question: I've been trying to gather survey respondents for 3 weeks and barely have half the sample size. The statistics aren't significant, and I feel like my entire research has failed.
topics.sample_answer: Research obstacles are an organic part of the scientific process. Inconclusive or difficult data isn't a failure—it's a finding. Let's discuss ways to expand your respondent reach or consult your advisor.
topics.keywords: data penelitian, kuesioner, responden, gagal eksperimen, statistik error, sampel data, izin penelitian

subcategories.name: Masa Depan, Karier & Quarter-Life Crisis
subcategories.description: Kebingungan arah pasca sarjana, pencarian kerja, magang, ketidakpastian finansial, dan kecemasan masa depan.

topics.name: Kebingungan Arah Karier & Menentukan Jalan Hidup Pasca Kampus
topics.description: Ketidakpastian minat dan bakat setelah lulus, keraguan apakah ingin berkarier sesuai jurusan, atau bingung mencari peluang kerja yang cocok.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami disorientasi karier. Bantu eksplorasi minat dan keahlian esensial tanpa menuntut keputusan mutlak saat ini juga.
suggested_chips: Bingung mau kerja apa habis lulus
Nggak yakin sama skill diri sendiri
Takut salah ambil jalur karier
Ngerasa nggak punya passion
topics.sample_question: I'm close to completing my degree, but I feel so confused about what career path to pursue. I don't even know what genuine success means for me anymore.
topics.sample_answer: Many graduates stand at this exact crossroad. Career paths are rarely straight lines; they are built through experimentation. Let's explore what activities genuinely energize you.
topics.keywords: career, karier, masa depan, bingung kerja, passion, arah hidup, pekerjaan, profesi, fresh graduate

topics.name: Kecemasan Menganggur & Persaingan Sengit Dunia Kerja
topics.description: Ketakutan menjadi pengangguran dalam waktu lama di tengah tingginya angka pelamar kerja dan kabar PHK massal di berbagai industri.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas menjadi pengangguran. Redakan rasa panik, fokuskan pada pengembangan portofolio dan pemeliharaan kesehatan mental di masa transisi.
suggested_chips: Takut jadi pengangguran setelah wisuda
Ngeri liat persaingan kerja sekarang
Cemas mikirin omongan tetangga kalau nganggur
Berita phk massal bikin makin pesimis
topics.sample_question: I read news about massive layoffs and thousands of applicants per job opening every day. I'm terrified I'll be unemployed for years and burden my family.
topics.sample_answer: Job market anxiety is overwhelming when you consume catastrophic headlines constantly. While the market is competitive, your individual journey is about finding your specific niche. Let's build your strengths.
topics.keywords: pengangguran, nganggur, cari kerja, persaingan kerja, phk, loker, fresh grad nganggur

topics.name: Frustrasi Penolakan Lamaran Kerja (Job Application Rejections)
topics.description: Patah semangat dan merasa tidak berharga setelah mengirimkan puluhan hingga ratusan CV tanpa ada panggilan atau mendapat email penolakan otomatis.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna patah semangat akibat penolakan bertubi-tubi. Pulihkan self-worth mereka dan ajarkan bahwa penolakan kerja tidak mendefinisikan nilai diri.
suggested_chips: Udah kirim puluhan CV tapi ditolak semua
Sakit hati dapat email penolakan otomatis
Ngerasa nggak ada perusahaan yang mau nerima aku
Capek disuruh nunggu kabar tanpa kepastian
topics.sample_question: I've sent out over 80 resumes for entry-level positions and internships, and only got rejection emails or ghosting. It makes me feel completely worthless.
topics.sample_answer: Job hunting rejections feel deeply personal, but remember: a rejection letter evaluates a match with a specific vacancy right now, not your human worth. Take a moment to rest before adjusting your strategy.
topics.keywords: ditolak kerja, lamaran kerja, cv ditolak, ghosting hrd, email penolakan, gagal rekrutmen, cari kerja

topics.name: Kegugupan Wawancara Kerja (Job Interview Anxiety) & Tes Masuk
topics.description: Rasa gugup luar biasa, gagap, atau nge-blank saat diwawancarai HRD/User atau saat mengikuti tes asesmen kerja.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas menghadapi interview kerja. Bantu latihan teknik STAR dan tenangkan respon gugup dengan persiapan terarah.
suggested_chips: Gemetar dan gagap pas wawancara kerja
Blank pas ditanya kelemahan diri oleh hrd
Takut ditanya pertanyaan teknis sulit
Grogi pas interview bahasa inggris
topics.sample_question: I have an interview with a top company tomorrow and I can't breathe. My mind blanks out every time someone asks me to introduce myself.
topics.sample_answer: Interview anxiety is your body's adrenal system trying to help you perform. Channel that nervous energy into curiosity. Practice answering using simple bullet points rather than reciting a rigid script.
topics.keywords: interview kerja, wawancara hrd, user interview, gugup wawancara, tes kerja, grogi interview

topics.name: Tekanan Finansial Mahasiswa, Biaya UKT & Kebutuhan Mandiri
topics.description: Kekhawatiran biaya semesteran, utang/kredit perkuliahan, kebutuhan mencari nafkah mandiri, atau beban kiriman uang dari orang tua yang terbatas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami stres finansial. Berikan dukungan realistis, fokus pada langkah pengelolaan prioritas dan sumber bantuan kampus.
suggested_chips: Pusing mikirin uang UKT/kuliah
Capek kerja sambilan sambil kuliah
Uang bulanan kosan pas-pasan banget
Pengen mandiri secara finansial tanpa nyusahin ortu
topics.sample_question: Funding my education is a daily struggle. Between paying tuition, rent, and daily meals, I barely have enough money to survive. The financial pressure is suffocating.
topics.sample_answer: Carrying financial weight while pursuing a degree is an enormous test of resilience. Acknowledging your courage is step one. Let's explore available emergency funds or campus work opportunities.
topics.keywords: financial, uang ukt, biaya kuliah, uang kos, kerja sambilan, part time, ekonomi pas pasan, uang makan

topics.name: Dilema Melanjutkan Studi (S2) vs Langsung Bekerja Mencari Nafkah
topics.description: Kebimbangan menentukan prioritas antara mencari beasiswa lanjut kuliah S2 atau segera bekerja demi mandiri secara finansial.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bimbang antara S2 atau kerja. Ajak mereka menimbang tujuan jangka panjang dan urgensi kebutuhan hidup saat ini secara realistis.
suggested_chips: Bingung mending lanjut S2 atau langsung kerja
Takut kalah saing kalau cuma S1
Dilema beasiswa S2 vs bantu ekonomi keluarga
Belum siap kerja tapi bosan kuliah
topics.sample_question: I can't decide whether to prepare for master's degree scholarships or take any entry job to support my family. I feel paralyzed by the fear of making the wrong choice.
topics.sample_answer: Neither choice closes your future permanently. Work experience can strengthen a future graduate application, and further study can open specialized doors. Let's weigh what aligns with your current priorities.
topics.keywords: lanjut s2, kuliah lagi, kerja vs s2, beasiswa s2, master degree, pilihan hidup, dilema lulus

topics.name: Stres Merintis Usaha / Startup Sendiri di Tengah Ketidakpastian Modal
topics.description: Tekanan membangun bisnis mandiri atau proyek rintisan, ketakutan modal habis, dan beban tanggung jawab pada mitra kerja.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami stres wirausaha pemula. Bantu kelola ketakutan risiko dan tekankan pentingnya memelihara stabilitas mental di samping pertumbuhan bisnis.
suggested_chips: Pusing mikirin modal usaha yang menipis
Takut bisnis yang dirintis gagal
Capek ngurusin operasional usaha sendirian
Stres mikirin penjualan yang sepi
topics.sample_question: I'm trying to launch a startup with my classmates, but our funding is running low and sales aren't growing. I feel solely responsible for everyone's hopes and I can't sleep.
topics.sample_answer: Entrepreneurship brings high rewards accompanied by immense uncertainty. You cannot solve every business dilemma overnight, especially on an exhausted mind. Let's prioritize what needs focus this week.
topics.keywords: bisnis, usaha, startup, modal usaha, jualan, wirausaha, bisnis mandiri, omset turun

subcategories.name: Sindrom Impostor & Perfeksionisme Akademik
subcategories.description: Merasa diri 'penipu' yang tidak layak berprestasi, ketakutan luar biasa akan kegagalan, dan standar kesempurnaan toksik.

topics.name: Imposter Syndrome (Merasa Bodoh dan Hanya Beruntung / Fraud)
topics.description: Keyakinan bahwa pencapaian selama ini hanyalah kebetulan atau keberuntungan semata, disertai ketakutan orang lain menyadari kekurangannya.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa dirinya tidak pantas. Ajak pengguna mencatat bukti konkret usahanya dan bedakan fakta objektif dari suara cemas dalam kepala.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa nggak pantas di jurusan ini
Takut ketahuan kalau sebenernya nggak pintar
Prestasi cuma karena hoki semata
Minder sama kecerdasan teman
topics.sample_question: Even when I receive high praise or good grades, I feel like a fraud who just fooled everyone. I'm constantly terrified that someday soon people will discover I'm not competent.
topics.sample_answer: What you are experiencing is Imposter Syndrome. Your achievements are earned through real effort, not luck. Let's look at the objective facts of what you've accomplished rather than the anxious narrative.
topics.keywords: imposter, impostor, fraud, merasa bodoh, tidak pantas, minder, hoki, beruntung, penipu

topics.name: Perfeksionisme Toksik (Takut Melakukan Kesalahan Sekecil Apapun)
topics.description: Menetapkan standar yang mustahil dicapai, sehingga kesalahan kecil saja memicu krisis kepercayaan diri dan keputusasaan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tersiksa oleh standar kesempurnaan pribadi. Ajak mereka mengadopsi pola pikir 'cukup baik untuk hari ini' (good enough is progress).
suggested_chips: Takut banget berbuat salah sekecil apapun
Sering ulang tugas dari nol karena ngerasa kurang
Menghukum diri sendiri kalau hasil meleset
Nggak puas sama hasil sendiri
topics.sample_question: I put unbearable pressure on myself to be flawless. If I make even a tiny mistake on an assignment, I feel like my entire credibility is ruined and I hate myself.
topics.sample_answer: Perfectionism often masquerades as ambition, but it's fueled by fear of inadequacy. Mistakes are evidence of learning, not proof of failure. Can we redefine progress today as being completed rather than perfect?
topics.keywords: perfectionism, perfeksionis, takut salah, standar tinggi, sempurna, flawless, menghukum diri

topics.name: Kebiasaan Membandingkan Prestasi dengan Teman di Kampus / Medsos
topics.description: Dorongan kompulsif membandingkan IPK, keikutsertaan lomba, dan magang dengan pencapaian teman di LinkedIn atau Instagram.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terjebak jebakan perbandingan sosial. Bantu mereka membatasi konsumsi pamer prestasi di medsos dan fokus pada kemajuan diri sendiri.
suggested_chips: Drop tiap liat pencapaian orang di LinkedIn
Ngerasa diri nggak ada apa-apanya dibanding teman
Iri liat teman udah magang di perusahaan keren
Capek ngebandingin diri terus
topics.sample_question: I spend hours scrolling LinkedIn and seeing peers win competitions, land prestigious internships, and get featured. I feel like a complete nobody who hasn't achieved anything.
topics.sample_answer: Social media shows highlighted victories, never the behind-the-scenes rejections and doubts. Comparing your unedited reality to someone else's highlight reel will always leave you feeling diminished. Focus on your lane.
topics.keywords: social comparison, linkedin, membandingkan diri, minder prestasi, iri pencapaian, pamer linkedin

topics.name: Standar Ekspektasi Pribadi yang Terlalu Tinggi & Menyiksa
topics.description: Menuntut diri sendiri harus serba bisa di bidang akademik, organisasi, dan pertemanan secara bersamaan hingga jatuh sakit.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna memasang ekspektasi di luar kapasitas fisik manusiawi. Bantu mereka menyadari batas kapasitas energi dan merestrukturisasi skala prioritas.
suggested_chips: Nuntut diri harus bisa segalanya
Nggak bisa terima kalau ada satu hal yang gagal
Pasang target terlalu tinggi sampai stres sendiri
Ngerasa harus jadi yang terbaik terus
topics.sample_question: I demand from myself that I must maintain a 4.0 GPA, lead a student club, and work part-time without any flaw. When I collapse from exhaustion, I blame myself for being weak.
topics.sample_answer: Expecting yourself to perform like an indefatigable machine is setting yourself up for heartbreak. Recognizing your human limits is wisdom, not weakness. Let's identify what you can take off your plate.
topics.keywords: ekspektasi tinggi, serba bisa, ambisius berlebihan, menuntut diri, target tinggi, ambisi toksik

topics.name: Rasa Bersalah yang Intens Saat Mendapatkan Nilai di Bawah Sempurna
topics.description: Merasa dunia runtuh dan membenci diri sendiri ketika mendapatkan nilai B atau C pada mata kuliah tertentu.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa bersalah atas nilai di bawah ekspektasi. Bantu dekonstruksi anggapan bahwa nilai huruf merefleksikan harga diri seutuhnya.
suggested_chips: Nilai B aja bikin nangis semalaman
Ngerasa gagal total gara-gara satu matkul
Malu liat KHS semester ini
Kecewa berat sama diri sendiri
topics.sample_question: I got a B in one of my major courses and I have spent three days crying in bed. I feel like I've ruined my academic record and let everyone down.
topics.sample_answer: It hurts when your hard work doesn't translate into the grade you aimed for. But a letter on a transcript is feedback on a specific exam, not a verdict on your intelligence or your future worth.
topics.keywords: nilai b, nilai c, khs, rasa bersalah, kecewa nilai, nilai jelek, bukan nilai a

topics.name: Ketakutan Dianggap Tidak Mampu oleh Rekan atau Dosen
topics.description: Kecemasan ekstrem bahwa rekan satu angkatan atau dosen menganggap dirinya tidak kompeten atau sekadar pelengkap saja.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas terhadap persepsi kompetensi dari orang lain. Kuatkan keyakinan diri dan fokus pada interaksi yang konstruktif.
suggested_chips: Takut dianggap remeh sama teman sekelas
Malu kalau keliatan bingung di depan dosen
Takut dibilang nggak kompeten
Nahan diri nggak mau nanya takut dikira bego
topics.sample_question: Whenever I work in a lab or a seminar, I stay silent because I'm terrified my classmates or professor will think my questions are stupid and realize I don't belong here.
topics.sample_answer: Everyone in that room experiences uncertainty, even if they appear confident. Asking questions is how real expertise is built. Your presence and curiosity are completely valid.
topics.keywords: takut diremehkan, dianggap bodoh, gengsi nanya, kompetensi, persepsi orang, minder kelas

topics.name: Kesulitan Mengakui & Merayakan Keberhasilan Diri Sendiri
topics.description: Ketidakmampuan merasa bangga saat meraih prestasi, selalu mengecilkan keberhasilan dengan menganggap 'semua orang juga bisa'.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna meremehkan pencapaian diri sendiri. Ajak latihan apresiasi diri (self-validation) dan mengizinkan diri merayakan kemenangan kecil.
suggested_chips: Susah ngerasa bangga sama pencapaian sendiri
Prestasi kemarin rasanya biasa aja
Ngerasa belum pantas dapet selamat
Langsung mikir beban berikutnya pas baru berhasil
topics.sample_question: When I won a scholarship, I didn't feel happy at all. I immediately thought they just didn't have enough applicants, and I started stressing about the next requirement.
topics.sample_answer: Deflecting your victories prevents your brain from feeling joy and satisfaction. You put in the hours, you submitted the application, and you won it. Allow yourself to pause and acknowledge that victory.
topics.keywords: tidak bisa bangga, meremehkan diri, self validation, tidak puas prestasi, merayakan pencapaian

name: Kesehatan Mental & Emosional
description: Pengelolaan kecemasan, suasana hati (mood), depresi, kelelahan mental berkepanjangan (burnout), serta pencarian makna diri.

subcategories.name: Kecemasan, Panik & Gelisah
subcategories.description: Respons takut berlebih, rasa tegang fisik, gelisah tak beralasan, hingga serangan panik akut.

topics.name: Kecemasan Umum & Perasaan Was-Was Sepanjang Hari Tanpa Sebab
topics.description: Kondisi gugup, was-was, dan gelisah sepanjang hari tanpa pemicu tunggal yang jelas, disertai ketegangan otot tubuh.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami generalized anxiety yang menguras energi. Gunakan teknik grounding napas 4-7-8 untuk menstabilkan kondisi fisiologis sebelum masuk ke akar pikiran.
suggested_chips: Gelisah terus tanpa sebab jelas
Dada rasanya sesak dan tegang
Selalu nunggu hal buruk terjadi
Khawatir berlebihan seharian
topics.sample_question: Hi, I've been feeling really nervous and anxious lately. I can't shake off this constant sense of dread, like something bad is always about to happen, even when everything is quiet.
topics.sample_answer: That persistent feeling of on-edge alertness is exhausting for your mind and body. Let's take a deep breath together right now. You are safe here, and we can unpack what's troubling you one thought at a time.
topics.keywords: anxiety, anxious, cemas, gelisah, was-was, khawatir, tegang, sesak, dread, gugup

topics.name: Serangan Panik (Panic Attack) & Respon Fisik Jantung Berdebar
topics.description: Lonjakan detak jantung hebat, keringat dingin, gemetar, dan rasa sesak napas seolah kehilangan kendali atas tubuh.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasakan sensasi serangan panik. Berikan respon tenang, instruksi grounding fisik yang jelas, dan ingatkan bahwa serangan panik akan mereda dan tidak mematikan.
suggested_chips: Jantung berdebar kencang tiba-tiba
Napas rasanya pendek dan tercekat
Tangan gemetar dan keringat dingin
Takut pingsan atau hilang kendali
topics.sample_question: My heart started beating uncontrollably, my palms were sweating, and I began to tremble. It felt like my body was stuck in fight-or-flight mode and I was in immediate danger.
topics.sample_answer: Focus on the soles of your feet touching the floor. Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts, hold for 4, and exhale gently for 6. Your body is experiencing a false alarm of panic, but you are physically safe.
topics.keywords: panic attack, serangan panik, jantung berdebar, deg-degan, keringat dingin, gemetar, sesak napas

topics.name: Kecemasan Anticipatory (Takut Terhadap Hal Buruk yang Belum Terjadi)
topics.description: Pikiran yang terus melompat ke skenario terburuk masa depan, merasa cemas sebelum peristiwa itu benar-benar terjadi.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tersiksa oleh kecemasan antisipatif. Bantu pisahkan antara 'kemungkinan teoritis' dengan 'kemungkinan realistis saat ini'.
suggested_chips: Takut banget sama hal yang belum tentu terjadi
Selalu mikirin skenario terburuk
Cemas beberapa hari sebelum acara dimulai
Capek mengkhawatirkan masa depan
topics.sample_question: I waste days anticipating everything that could go wrong with presentations or trips. By the time the event happens, I'm already mentally drained from worrying.
topics.sample_answer: Anticipatory anxiety makes us suffer a hypothetical scenario a hundred times before it even happens. Bring your focus back to what is true in this present room right now.
topics.keywords: anticipatory anxiety, takut masa depan, skenario terburuk, cemas duluan, khawatir berlebihan

topics.name: Ketegangan Otot, Sesak Napas & Gelisah Sulit Duduk Diam
topics.description: Manifestasi fisik kecemasan berupa pundak kaku, rahang terkunci, perut mual/melilit, dan tubuh tidak bisa rileks.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami gejala somatisasi kecemasan fisik. Pandu relaksasi otot progresif untuk melepaskan ketegangan tubuh.
suggested_chips: Pundak dan leher kaku banget karena cemas
Perut melilit tiap kepikiran masalah
Nggak bisa duduk diam dan gelisah
Badan tegang terus seharian
topics.sample_question: My anxiety settles directly into my physical body. My shoulders are constantly clenched like rocks, my jaw hurts from grinding, and my stomach feels like it's in knots.
topics.sample_answer: Your body is holding onto emotional stress physically. Drop your shoulders away from your ears right now. Unclench your jaw. Take a slow, deep belly breath and feel the release.
topics.keywords: somatisasi, otot tegang, rahang kaku, leher tegang, perut melilit, sesak napas, gelisah fisik

topics.name: Fobia Spesifik Terkait Situasi Kampus (Ruang Ujian, Lift, Kerumunan)
topics.description: Ketakutan ekstrem terhadap ruang tertutup di kampus, lift gedung perkuliahan, atau kerumunan kantin yang memicu panik.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna menghadapi pemicu fobia situasional. Bantu teknik desensitisasi bertahap dan afirmasi rasa aman di lingkungan kampus.
suggested_chips: Takut naik lift gedung kampus
Panik kalau masuk ruangan ujian yang sepi
Nggak kuat berada di kantin yang ramai
Pengen lari pas berada di kerumunan
topics.sample_question: I get intense claustrophobia and panic in university elevators or crowded lecture halls. I end up climbing ten flights of stairs just to avoid panic attacks.
topics.sample_answer: Phobic responses can be exhausting and limiting. Acknowledging the fear without shaming yourself is crucial. Let's look at grounding tools you can carry when facing these triggers.
topics.keywords: fobia, lift kampus, kerumunan, klaustrofobia, ruang ujian, takut ramai, panik tempat umum

topics.name: Ketakutan Kehilangan Kendali Atas Pikiran Sendiri (Intrusive Thoughts)
topics.description: Munculnya pikiran aneh, menakutkan, atau mengganggu secara tiba-tiba yang membuat pengguna takut dirinya akan menjadi gila.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tertekan oleh intrusive thoughts. Jelaskan bahwa pikiran intrusif adalah fenomena umum dan memikirkan sesuatu tidak sama dengan melakukannya.
suggested_chips: Pikiran aneh dan seram suka muncul tiba-tiba
Takut hilang kendali atas pikiran sendiri
Takut jadi gila karena pikiran ini
Susah mengusir pikiran buruk yang masuk
topics.sample_question: I have these horrifying intrusive thoughts that pop into my head out of nowhere, and it terrifies me. I feel like I'm losing my mind or turning into a monster.
topics.sample_answer: Intrusive thoughts feel deeply disturbing, but having a thought does not mean you desire it or will act on it. The distress you feel proves it doesn't align with your values. Let it pass like clouds.
topics.keywords: intrusive thoughts, pikiran mengganggu, takut gila, hilang kendali, pikiran aneh, cemas pikiran

topics.name: Hipokondria (Kecemasan Kesehatan Fisik yang Berlebihan)
topics.description: Kecenderungan mencari gejala penyakit di Google (cyberchondria) dan panik berlebihan meyakini diri terkena penyakit mematikan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas kesehatan (health anxiety). Sarankan menghentikan kebiasaan browsing gejala di internet dan konsultasikan ke dokter umum jika perlu.
suggested_chips: Suka googling gejala penyakit sampai panik
Tiap ada sensasi aneh di tubuh dikira sakit parah
Takut kena penyakit mematikan
Sering bolak-balik cek denyut nadi
topics.sample_question: Every time I feel a minor twitch or headache, I search online and convince myself I have a terminal illness. I can't stop checking my pulse every ten minutes.
topics.sample_answer: Cyberchondria creates an endless feedback loop of fear. Google searches are designed to list rare severe conditions alongside common ones. Let's practice putting the search phone down.
topics.keywords: health anxiety, hipokondria, googling penyakit, takut sakit, cyberchondria, cek nadi, panik gejala

subcategories.name: Depresi, Kesedihan & Kehilangan Minat
subcategories.description: Suasana hati murung, rasa hampa, kehilangan ketertarikan pada aktivitas sehari-hari, dan perasaan putus asa.

topics.name: Kesedihan Mendalam yang Menetap & Sering Menangis Spontan
topics.description: Perasaan murung berkepanjangan selama berminggu-minggu, kekosongan di dada, dan dorongan menangis tanpa pemicu yang jelas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa sedih mendalam. Jangan tawarkan positivisme toksik. Validasi bahwa rasa sedih itu nyata dan berikan kehadiran yang hangat.
suggested_chips: Sedih mendalam berminggu-minggu
Tiba-tiba nangis tanpa alasan jelas
Dada rasanya berat dan sesak oleh kesedihan
Ngerasa sedih yang nggak kunjung usai
topics.sample_question: I've been feeling deeply sad for weeks. A heavy cloud follows me everywhere, and sometimes I just burst into tears while washing dishes for no apparent reason.
topics.sample_answer: It takes courage to admit how heavy things feel inside. You don't have to force yourself to smile or pretend you're fine right now. I am here to sit with you through this sadness.
topics.keywords: depress, depressed, sedih, murung, menangis spontan, hampa, awan gelap, kesedihan berlarut

topics.name: Rasa Hampa (Emptiness) & Merasa 'Mati Rasa' Secara Emosional
topics.description: Kondisi tidak merasakan apa-apa; tidak bisa merasa sedih, gembira, atau marah, melainkan kekosongan emosi yang membingungkan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami emotional numbness/emptiness. Jelaskan bahwa mati rasa adalah mekanisme pertahanan otak saat kewalahan emosi.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa hampa dan kosong di dalam
Nggak bisa ngerasain sedih atau senang
Merasa mati rasa secara emosi
Hidup rasanya kayak cuma nonton film
topics.sample_question: I don't even feel sad anymore; I just feel completely numb and empty inside. It feels like someone turned down the volume of all emotions and I'm just an empty shell.
topics.sample_answer: Emotional numbness is often your mind's emergency brake when feelings become too overwhelming to process. It is a protective response, not a permanent state. You will reconnect in time.
topics.keywords: hampa, emptiness, mati rasa, numb, kosong, emosi mati, flat, shell, tidak punya rasa

topics.name: Anhedonia (Kehilangan Minat Total pada Hobi & Hal yang Dulu Disukai)
topics.description: Aktivitas, musik, olahraga, atau hobi yang dulunya sangat membahagiakan kini terasa tawar, membosankan, dan tidak lagi memicu rasa gembira.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami anhedonia. Ajak mereka tidak memaksakan 'harus senang', melainkan fokus pada gerakan kecil tanpa ekspektasi euforia.
suggested_chips: Hobi yang biasa disuka jadi hambar
Nggak ada hal yang bikin semangat lagi
Hari-hari rasanya monoton dan flat
Ngerasa mati rasa terhadap kesenangan
topics.sample_question: I used to love listening to music, drawing, and walking in nature, but lately even those things have lost their appeal. Everything just feels gray and uninteresting.
topics.sample_answer: Losing interest in things you once loved is one of the clearest signs of depleted emotional reserves. Don't force joy; treat this as an invitation to rest your brain without guilt.
topics.keywords: anhedonia, hambar, hilang minat, hobi bosan, gray, tidak bersemangat, monoton, flat

topics.name: Kehilangan Energi Fisik & Berat Melakukan Aktivitas Mandi/Bangun
topics.description: Kelesuan ekstrem di mana bangun dari tempat tidur, sikat gigi, mandi, atau makan terasa seperti mendaki gunung yang sangat berat.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami psychomotor retardation/kelelahan depresif. Puji usaha sekecil apapun (misal sudah minum air) dan bantu target mikro harian.
suggested_chips: Bangun dari kasur rasanya berat banget
Malas mandi dan makan berhari-hari
Energi fisik habis total padahal nggak ngapa-ngapain
Cuma pengen rebahan di kamar gelap
topics.sample_question: Getting out of bed, showering, or even brushing my teeth feels like an insurmountable mountain. I've spent days lying in the dark because my limbs feel made of lead.
topics.sample_answer: When emotional batteries are depleted, basic physical tasks feel exhausting. Surviving today and drinking a glass of water is already an achievement. Be extremely gentle with yourself.
topics.keywords: kehilangan energi, lemas fisik, malas mandi, berat bangun kasur, rebahan, lelah depresi

topics.name: Perasaan Tidak Berharga (Worthlessness) & Beban bagi Orang Lain
topics.description: Keyakinan mendalam bahwa keberadaan diri di dunia tidak berguna dan hanya menyusahkan orang tua atau teman di sekitarnya.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa dirinya beban (burdensomeness). Berikan afirmasi bahwa pikiran depresif mendistorsi kenyataan dan nyatakan bahwa kehadiran mereka berharga.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa cuma jadi beban buat orang tua
Merasa hidupku nggak ada gunanya
Ngerasa nggak berharga dan sia-sia
Pikiran bahwa orang lain bakal lebih baik tanpa aku
topics.sample_question: I constantly feel like a giant burden to my parents and friends. I contribute nothing, waste their money, and feel like they would all be better off without me around.
topics.sample_answer: Depression lies by telling you that you are a burden. The fact that you care about your loved ones shows your deep empathy. You have inherent value, regardless of what you produce.
topics.keywords: tidak berharga, beban orang lain, menyusahkan ortu, worthlessness, sia-sia, merasa tidak berguna

topics.name: Pandangan Pesimistis & Keputusasaan Terhadap Hari Esok
topics.description: Keyakinan suram bahwa masa depan tidak akan pernah membaik, segala upaya akan sia-sia, dan tidak ada harapan yang tersisa.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tenggelam dalam keputusasaan. Fokuskan perhatian pada 'hari ini saja' (one day at a time) daripada memikirkan tahun-tahun ke depan.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa masa depan nggak bakal membaik
Putus asa sama keadaan hidup
Apapun yang kulakuin rasanya bakal sia-sia
Nggak ada harapan buat hari esok
topics.sample_question: I can't see any light at the end of the tunnel. It feels like my life is permanently broken and no amount of effort or therapy will ever make things better.
topics.sample_answer: Hopelessness is an emotional filter that blinds us to future possibilities. When tomorrow feels too heavy to look at, just focus on navigating the next single hour.
topics.keywords: putus asa, hopeless, pesimistis, masa depan suram, tidak ada harapan, sia sia, gelap

topics.name: Fluktuasi Suasana Hati Ekstrem (Mood Swings) yang Melelahkan
topics.description: Perubahan mood yang drastis dari bersemangat tiba-tiba menjadi sangat sedih atau mudah marah dalam waktu singkat tanpa alasan jelas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bingung dengan mood swings mereka. Bantu membuat mood tracker dan identifikasi pemicu fluktuasi hormon, tidur, atau stres.
suggested_chips: Mood gampang berubah drastis
Pagi semangat sore tiba-tiba nangis
Emosi nggak stabil bikin capek sendiri
Suka tiba-tiba uring-uringan
topics.sample_question: My emotions swing violently from one extreme to another. In the morning I feel motivated, and by the afternoon I'm sobbing in despair. It's making me dizzy and exhausted.
topics.sample_answer: Riding an emotional rollercoaster is deeply draining. Hormonal shifts, sleep deficit, and unexpressed stress often trigger these swings. Let's track when these shifts happen.
topics.keywords: mood swing, suasana hati labil, emosi naik turun, emosi tidak stabil, uring uringan, mood labil

subcategories.name: Burnout & Kelelahan Mental Kronis
subcategories.description: Habisnya daya tampung psikis akibat stres terus-menerus tanpa regenerasi istirahat yang memadai.

topics.name: Kelelahan Emosional Total (Emotional Exhaustion) Akibat Beban Rutinitas
topics.description: Kondisi kehabisan bahan bakar energi emosional; bangun tidur tetap lelah, mudah tersinggung, dan kewalahan oleh hal-hal sepele.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami burnout tingkat tinggi. Prioritaskan izin untuk istirahat total, evaluasi beban hidup harian, dan hindari dorongan produktivitas paksa.
suggested_chips: Energi habis total luar dalam
Bangun tidur badan tetap capek
Kewalahan sama hal-hal sepele
Pengen rehat dari rutinitas hidup
topics.sample_question: I've been feeling completely overwhelmed lately. The constant pressure and responsibilities have drained all my energy, and I feel like I'm breaking down.
topics.sample_answer: You are running on an empty emotional tank. Burnout is your nervous system's way of forcing you to hit the brakes. Right now, rest isn't a reward to be earned—it is an absolute biological necessity.
topics.keywords: burnout, kelelahan emosional, habis energi, overwhelmed, drain, kewalahan, remuk, capek jiwa

topics.name: Sinisme & Hilangnya Kepedulian pada Kuliah/Organisasi (Depersonalisasi)
topics.description: Sikap acuh tak acuh, sinis, dan hilangnya empati terhadap perkuliahan, tugas, atau organisasi mahasiswa yang dulunya diperjuangkan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami fase depersonalisasi burnout. Sadarkan bahwa sikap sinis adalah mekanisme perlindungan diri dari rasa sakit kelelahan.
suggested_chips: Udah nggak peduli lagi sama hasil kuliah
Jadi sinis dan bodo amat sama tugas
Hilang empati sama urusan organisasi
Rasanya pengen cabut dari semuanya
topics.sample_question: I used to care so much about my campus projects, but now I feel cynical and totally indifferent. When people ask for help, I just want them to leave me alone.
topics.sample_answer: Cynicism and detachment in burnout are protective armor. When you give too much for too long, your mind shuts off empathy to prevent total collapse. You need serious recharging.
topics.keywords: sinisme, depersonalisasi, bodo amat, masa bodoh, tidak peduli, acuh, burnout organisasi

topics.name: Penurunan Drastis Efektivitas Diri (Merasa Tidak Pernah Efektif)
topics.description: Perasaan bahwa betapa kerasnya berusaha, hasil kerja selalu lambat, buruk, dan tidak mencapai kualitas yang diharapkan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa tidak kompeten akibat kelelahan kognitif. Jelaskan bahwa otak yang lelah mengalami penurunan fungsi eksekutif wajar.
suggested_chips: Ngerjain tugas rasanya lambat banget
Efektivitas belajar terjun bebas
Ngerasa otak lemot dan tumpul
Kerja seharian tapi nggak ada hasil
topics.sample_question: No matter how many hours I spend staring at my screen, I barely produce one usable paragraph. I feel completely ineffective and incompetent.
topics.sample_answer: When your cognitive battery is drained, your brain's prefrontal cortex literally slows down. Staring at the screen won't fix it; a genuine cognitive break will.
topics.keywords: penurunan efektivitas, otak lemot, tumpul, kerja lambat, fungsi kognitif turun, burnout belajar

topics.name: Beban Ganda Mahasiswa Pekerja (Kuliah Sambil Bekerja / Freelance)
topics.description: Kelelahan fisik dan mental ekstrem akibat harus membagi waktu antara jadwal kuliah padat dan tuntutan pekerjaan mencari nafkah.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami double burden kuliah dan kerja. Bantu buat batasan ketat antara jam kerja, jam kuliah, dan jam istirahat mutlak.
suggested_chips: Capek banget kuliah sambil kerja shift
Nggak punya waktu istirahat sama sekali
Badan remuk bagi waktu antara kantor dan kampus
Tugas kuliah terbengkalai karena kerjaan
topics.sample_question: I work 30 hours a week to pay my tuition while taking a full course load. I haven't had a proper day off in six months, and my body is physically breaking down.
topics.sample_answer: Balancing employment and higher education is a heroic feat that takes an immense physical toll. Let's look at your weekly schedule and carve out non-negotiable pockets of rest.
topics.keywords: kuliah kerja, mahasiswa pekerja, freelance, shift kerja, beban ganda, part time burnout

topics.name: Burnout Organisasi Mahasiswa (BEM / HIMA / Kepanitiaan Beruntun)
topics.description: Tekanan politik internal organisasi, rapat larut malam yang tiada henti, dan tuntutan menyukseskan acara kampus tanpa apresiasi sepadan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna lelah aktif di organisasi kampus. Berikan validasi bahwa mereka berhak mengundurkan diri atau mendelegasikan tugas demi kesehatan mental.
suggested_chips: Capek rapat BEM sampai subuh
Tekanan jadi ketua panitia acara kampus
Drama internal organisasi bikin stres
Pengen mundur dari kepanitiaan
topics.sample_question: Being on the student council executive board is draining my soul. Midnight meetings, endless drama, and angry complaints from members are making me hate university.
topics.sample_answer: Student organizations should be leadership learning spaces, not emotional sweatshops. You have the right to step back, set boundaries on meeting times, or resign if it harms your health.
topics.keywords: bem, hima, organisasi kampus, kepanitiaan, rapat subuh, ketua panitia, burnout organisasi

topics.name: Rasa Bersalah Akut Saat Mengambil Jeda atau Berlibur
topics.description: Kecenderungan merasa cemas, bersalah, atau menganggap diri pemalas setiap kali mencoba rehat atau tidak melakukan pekerjaan produktif.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa bersalah saat santai/istirahat. Bantu dekonstruksi mitos 'nilai manusia ditentukan oleh produktivitas tanpa henti'.
suggested_chips: Kalau istirahat ngerasa bersalah banget
Ngerasa pemalas kalau nggak produktif
Nggak bisa santai tanpa mikir kerjaan
Liburan malah gelisah
topics.sample_question: It's so hard for me to stop working. When I try to relax or do nothing, this hidden anxiety nags at me that I should be doing something productive, making me feel guilty.
topics.sample_answer: When our self-worth is tied strictly to output, rest feels like laziness. But rest is an active part of staying human and healthy. Let's practice giving yourself permission to just 'be'.
topics.keywords: guilt, rasa bersalah, rest, istirahat, toxic productivity, pemalas, santai, produktif

topics.name: Kelelahan Kronis yang Tidak Hilang Meskipun Sudah Tidur Berjam-jam
topics.description: Rasa capek yang mendalam pada tingkat seluler/mental yang tidak sembuh hanya dengan tidur seharian di akhir pekan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami chronic fatigue akibat stres berkepanjangan. Bedakan antara istirahat fisik (tidur) dengan istirahat mental/sensorik.
suggested_chips: Tidur 10 jam tapi bangun tetap capek
Capeknya bukan di badan tapi di pikiran
Seharian tidur nggak bikin seger
Badan lemas berkepanjangan
topics.sample_question: I slept for twelve hours on Sunday, yet on Monday morning I felt just as heavy and exhausted as before. Physical sleep isn't fixing this deep internal fatigue.
topics.sample_answer: Sleep restores the body, but it doesn't cure mental, emotional, and sensory overload. You need emotional rest—freedom from expectations, judgment, and digital noise.
topics.keywords: kelelahan kronis, bangun tetap capek, chronic fatigue, tidur tidak memulihkan, lelah mental

subcategories.name: Overthinking, Ruminasi & Self-Criticism
subcategories.description: Pikiran yang berputar tanpa henti, memutar ulang kejadian memalukan, dan kritik diri internal yang kejam.

topics.name: Pikiran Berputar di Malam Hari Menjelang Tidur (Racing Thoughts)
topics.description: Serbuan skenario buruk dan overthinking ketika hendak tidur, membuat otak tetap aktif dan menolak terlelap.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tersiksa overthinking malam hari. Sarankan metode 'Brain Dump' (menuliskan semua pikiran ke kertas) sebelum tidur agar beban pikiran berpindah dari kepala.
suggested_chips: Tiap mau tidur pikiran langsung ribut
Muterin skenario buruk yang belum terjadi
Otak nggak bisa berhenti mikir
Capek sama pikiran sendiri
topics.sample_question: My mind keeps racing late at night and I get so uncomfortable. I find myself constantly spiraling over past mistakes and future fears until my head hurts.
topics.sample_answer: The quiet of the night often gives worries a louder microphone. Try writing every single racing thought onto a piece of paper beside your bed to tell your brain: 'These are safe here, we will handle them tomorrow.'
topics.keywords: overthinking, racing thoughts, pikiran malam, otak muter, susah tidur overthink, spiral

topics.name: Ruminasi Kesalahan Masa Lalu & Memutar Ulang Momen Memalukan
topics.description: Terjebak memutar ulang percakapan canggung, kegagalan masa lalu, atau keputusan keliru bertahun-tahun yang lalu secara berulang.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terjebak ruminasi masa lalu. Ajak mereka menyadari bahwa keputusan masa lalu diambil berdasarkan kapasitas dan pengetahuan saat itu.
suggested_chips: Sering keingat momen memalukan bertahun-tahun lalu
Menyesali keputusan yang udah lewat
Muter ulang percakapan tadi siang di kepala
Kenapa dulu aku sebodoh itu?
topics.sample_question: I find myself constantly replaying an awkward comment I made three years ago, or a mistake on an exam, cringing and wishing I could rewrite history.
topics.sample_answer: Ruminating on the past is your brain trying to solve a problem that has already finished. You made choices based on the information you had then. Forgive that earlier version of you.
topics.keywords: ruminasi, masa lalu, momen memalukan, penyesalan, overthinking masa lalu, memutar ulang

topics.name: Skenario Terburuk (Catastrophizing) di Pikiran yang Membuat Cemas
topics.description: Kebiasaan membesar-besarkan masalah kecil menjadi bencana besar (misal: satu tugas telat dikira pasti gagal lulus dan masa depan hancur).
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna melakukan catastrophizing. Bantu menguji asumsi ekstrem dengan bertanya: 'Apa skenario yang paling mungkin terjadi secara realistis?'.
suggested_chips: Pikiran suka melebih-lebihkan masalah
Satu kesalahan kecil dikira bakal hancurin masa depan
Panik berlebihan mikir hal terburuk
Otak suka bikin film bencana sendiri
topics.sample_question: If a professor doesn't smile at me, I immediately think they hate me, will fail my paper, and I'll get expelled. I jump straight from zero to catastrophe.
topics.sample_answer: Catastrophic thinking takes a tiny seed of uncertainty and blows it up into a disaster movie. Let's examine the actual evidence: has a neutral face ever resulted in expulsion?
topics.keywords: catastrophizing, skenario terburuk, lebay mikir, membesar besarkan masalah, panik sendiri

topics.name: Kritik Diri Internal yang Kejam (Harsh Inner Critic)
topics.description: Suara di dalam kepala yang selalu mencaci maki, merendahkan, dan mengatakan bahwa diri sendiri payah, lambat, atau tidak berharga.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tersiksa oleh inner critic kejam. Ajak membedakan suara kritik toksik dari suara bijak diri, dan perlakukan diri seperti seorang sahabat tercinta.
suggested_chips: Suara di kepalaku jahat banget
Suka ngatain diri sendiri bego dan payah
Nggak pernah ada kata positif buat diri sendiri
Kritik diri kejam tiada henti
topics.sample_question: My inner voice constantly bullies me. Whenever I drop something or forget an item, it whispers: 'You are so utterly useless and pathetic.' I can't escape it.
topics.sample_answer: Would you let anyone speak to your best friend the way that inner voice speaks to you? You deserve kindness from the person you spend the most time with: yourself.
topics.keywords: inner critic, kritik diri, mengutuk diri, suara jahat, menghina diri sendiri, self deprecation

topics.name: Kecenderungan Menyalahkan Diri Sendiri (Self-Blame) Atas Segala Masalah
topics.description: Menganggap setiap pertengkaran teman, kekecewaan orang lain, atau kejadian buruk di lingkungan sekitar adalah kesalahan diri sendiri.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna memikul tanggung jawab atas hal di luar kendalinya. Bantu memetakan lingkaran kendali (Circle of Control).
suggested_chips: Selalu ngerasa semua masalah salahku
Merasa bersalah kalau orang lain bad mood
Cenderung minta maaf berlebihan
Nyalahin diri atas hal di luar kendali
topics.sample_question: Whenever a group project stumbles or a friend gets upset, my immediate reaction is to apologize and assume I caused it somehow. I carry the blame for everything.
topics.sample_answer: Taking responsibility for other adults' emotions and external variables is exhausting. You are only responsible for your own intentions and actions, not the entire world's weather.
topics.keywords: self blame, menyalahkan diri, minta maaf berlebihan, merasa bersalah, di luar kendali

topics.name: Keraguan Ekstrem dalam Pengambilan Keputusan (Analysis Paralysis)
topics.description: Ketakutan luar biasa membuat pilihan yang salah, menyebabkan terjebak menimbang-nimbang tanpa pernah mengambil tindakan nyata.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna lumpuh analisis (analysis paralysis). Sarankan teknik batasan waktu keputusan dan ingatkan bahwa tidak ada keputusan yang 100% bebas risiko.
suggested_chips: Susah banget ambil keputusan penting
Takut salah langkah terus-menerus
Menganalisis hal kecil sampai pusing sendiri
Akhirnya nggak ngelakuin apa-apa
topics.sample_question: I get paralyzed when making decisions—from choosing a thesis topic to picking a minor. I research endlessly, terrified that picking option A will ruin option B.
topics.sample_answer: Analysis paralysis is perfectionism disguised as prudence. In life, clarity comes from engagement, not endless contemplation. Pick the best good-enough option and adjust along the way.
topics.keywords: analysis paralysis, ragu ambil keputusan, bingung milih, takut salah langkah, overthinking pilihan

topics.name: Sulit Melepaskan Komentar Negatif atau Kritikan Orang Lain
topics.description: Kritik atau komentar pedas satu orang terus terngiang-ngiang selama berminggu-minggu, menenggelamkan puluhan pujian positif yang pernah diterima.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terpaku pada kritik negatif (negativity bias). Bantu membedakan kritik yang membangun dari proyeksian emosi orang lain.
suggested_chips: Komentar pedas satu orang kepikiran berminggu-minggu
Susah nerima kritik tanpa merasa hancur
Mengabaikan pujian tapi fokus ke celaan
Sakit hati omongan orang lain
topics.sample_question: Someone criticized my presentation style two weeks ago, and that single sentence is still replaying in my mind every hour, completely wiping out all the compliments I received.
topics.sample_answer: Our human brains have an evolutionary negativity bias, clinging to criticism like velcro. Remember: feedback is data about their preference, not a definition of your core worth.
topics.keywords: komentar negatif, kritikan pedas, kepikiran omongan orang, negativity bias, sakit hati kritik

subcategories.name: Krisis Eksistensial & Regulasi Emosi
subcategories.description: Kebimbangan filosofis mengenai arti kehidupan, pencarian identitas sejati, dan perasaan disorientasi tujuan.

topics.name: Krisis Eksistensial & Mempertanyakan Makna Kehidupan
topics.description: Mempertanyakan untuk apa semua kerja keras ini dilakukan, merasa hidup hanya rutinitas tanpa makna, dan hilangnya jangkar identitas diri.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mempertanyakan eksistensi hidup. Pandu mereka dengan pendekatan logoterapi: makna hidup diciptakan melalui tindakan kecil sehari-hari dan hubungan yang jujur.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa hidup nggak ada artinya
Buat apa semua ini dilakuin?
Bingung tujuan hidup sebenarnya
Ngerasa hilang arah dan jati diri
topics.sample_question: Lately I've been feeling like I lost contact with who I was before, with my dreams and my passions. It feels like I'm watching my life drift away with no sense of real purpose.
topics.sample_answer: Existential questioning often happens when old identities no longer fit who we are becoming. It's not a dead end, but an invitation to redefine what truly matters to you on your own terms.
topics.keywords: existential, makna hidup, purpose, jati diri, hampa, tujuan, identity crisis, arti hidup

topics.name: Kehilangan Jati Diri & Merasa Tidak Mengenal Diri Sendiri Lagi
topics.description: Perasaan asing terhadap diri sendiri setelah mengalami serangkaian kegagalan, patah hati, atau perubahan lingkungan yang drastis.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa kehilangan identitas. Ajak mereka melihat transisi ini sebagai ruang kanvas kosong untuk menemukan kembali versi diri yang lebih autentik.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa asing sama diri sendiri
Aku sebenarnya orang yang seperti apa?
Kehilangan jati diri setelah banyak masalah
Pengen kenal lagi sama diri sendiri
topics.sample_question: I looked in the mirror yesterday and felt like I was looking at a complete stranger. I don't know what I like, what I stand for, or who I even am anymore.
topics.sample_answer: Losing your old identity is disorienting, but it usually means you have outgrown old boxes that no longer serve you. You get to rebuild and discover who you are today.
topics.keywords: jati diri, kehilangan identitas, asing diri sendiri, pencarian jati diri, who am i, identitas diri

topics.name: Kesulitan Mengidentifikasi & Mengungkapkan Emosi (Alexithymia)
topics.description: Ketidakmampuan menamai apa yang dirasakan di dalam dada; hanya merasa 'tidak enak' atau 'meledak' tanpa tahu apakah itu marah, sedih, atau kecewa.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kesulitan mengenali emosi. Gunakan 'Roda Emosi' (Emotion Wheel) untuk memperkaya kosakata emosi dan membedakan rasa sedih dari kecewa.
suggested_chips: Bingung ngejelasin apa yang kurasain
Cuma ngerasa nggak enak tapi nggak tahu kenapa
Susah ungkapin perasaan ke orang lain
Emosi numpuk di dada tapi nggak bisa keluar
topics.sample_question: When my counselor asks me what I'm feeling, my brain goes completely blank. I know my body hurts and I'm stressed, but I have no words to describe my emotions.
topics.sample_answer: Putting words to feelings is a learned skill, not an innate reflex. When you can't name the emotion, start with the physical sensation: where in your body do you feel tension?
topics.keywords: alexithymia, susah ungkapin rasa, roda emosi, tidak bisa menamai emosi, emosi buntu

topics.name: Ledakan Kemarahan (Anger Outbursts) & Emosi yang Meletup-letup
topics.description: Gampang tersulut emosi, membanting barang, membentak orang sekitar atas hal sepele, lalu diikuti penyesalan mendalam.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kesulitan meregulasi amarah. Jelaskan bahwa amarah seringkali adalah emosi sekunder yang menutupi rasa sakit hati atau ketidakberdayaan.
suggested_chips: Gampang banget emosi dan meledak
Hal sepele bikin naik darah
Suka nyesel habis marah-marah ke orang
Marah jadi pelampiasan rasa capek
topics.sample_question: I lost my temper yesterday over a tiny misunderstanding and screamed at my roommate. Afterwards I felt so ashamed. My anger feels like an untamed fire lately.
topics.sample_answer: Anger is often a secondary emotion—a fiery bodyguard protecting vulnerable feelings of hurt, exhaustion, or feeling disrespected. Let's look at what's underneath that fire.
topics.keywords: marah, anger, meledak, emosian, gampang tersinggung, amarah meletup, temperamen, nyesel marah

topics.name: Sensitivitas Berlebihan (Highly Sensitive Person / Mudah Terluka)
topics.description: Merasa terlalu peka terhadap nada bicara orang lain, ekspresi wajah dingin, atau keributan sensorik yang menguras energi batin.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna memiliki sifat Highly Sensitive Person (HSP). Validasi bahwa kepekaan adalah kekuatan empati, asalkan dilengkapi perlindungan batas emosional.
suggested_chips: Gampang banget tersinggung dan kepikiran
Peka banget sama perubahan nada bicara orang
Mudah capek di lingkungan berisik
Terlalu sensitif kata orang lain
topics.sample_question: People always tell me I'm 'too sensitive' or 'taking things too personally.' A slightly cold tone of voice from a friend will ruin my entire day.
topics.sample_answer: Being highly sensitive is not a flaw; it means your nervous system processes subtle information deeply. You have high empathy. Let's build healthy filters so you don't absorb everyone else's energy.
topics.keywords: hsp, highly sensitive, terlalu peka, baperan, mudah tersinggung, sensitivitas tinggi, peka

topics.name: Rasa Bersalah Ketika Merasakan Kebahagiaan di Tengah Masalah
topics.description: Merasa tidak berhak bersenang-senang, tertawa, atau bahagia saat keluarga sedang sulit atau saat masih memiliki banyak tanggungan tugas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa bersalah saat bahagia. Ingatkan bahwa menikmati kebahagiaan sejenak tidak menghapus kepedulian mereka terhadap masalah yang ada.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa bersalah kalau lagi ketawa senang
Takut bahagia karena biasanya habis itu ada musibah
Nggak berhak senang pas keluarga lagi susah
Menahan diri buat bahagia
topics.sample_question: Whenever I have fun with friends, a wave of guilt hits me that I don't deserve joy while my family is struggling financially. It's like I forbid myself from being happy.
topics.sample_answer: Experiencing joy does not mean you don't care about your family's struggles. In fact, replenishing your happiness is what gives you the strength to be supportive. You are allowed to smile.
topics.keywords: guilt happiness, bersalah saat bahagia, takut senang, tidak berhak bahagia, menahan tawa

topics.name: Kebingungan Membedakan Nilai Pribadi vs Tuntutan Lingkungan
topics.description: Dilema batin apakah cita-cita dan standar hidup yang diperjuangkan selama ini murni keinginan sendiri atau sekadar dogma masyarakat.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengevaluasi ulang nilai hidup. Bantu mereka memetakan nilai inti (core values) yang sejati bagi kedamaian mereka.
suggested_chips: Bingung ini kemauanku atau tuntutan orang lain
Selama ini cuma ngikutin standar sosial
Pengen tahu apa yang bener-bener kumau
Capek hidup sesuai ekspektasi umum
topics.sample_question: I realized recently that my ambition to work in finance wasn't mine at all; it was just what society and prestige dictated. Now I'm questioning all my values.
topics.sample_answer: Realizing you've been living on autopilot according to other people's scripts is liberating, even if it feels destabilizing. You now have the power to define your own authentic metrics of success.
topics.keywords: nilai hidup, core values, tuntutan sosial, standar masyarakat, ekspektasi umum, hidup autentik

name: Relasi Interpersonal & Sosial
description: Dinamika pertemanan kampus, circle, hubungan keluarga & orang tua, romansa & patah hati, kecemasan sosial, serta penetapan batasan.

subcategories.name: Pertemanan, Circle & Peer Pressure
subcategories.description: Konflik dengan sahabat, rasa terisolasi dari kelompok sebaya, FOMO, dan tekanan gaya hidup kelompok.

topics.name: Konflik Argumen, Salah Paham & Ketegangan Circle Sahabat
topics.description: Perselisihan argumen dalam kelompok sahabat, perbedaan pandangan saat liburan/tugas, dan ketegangan yang merusak keakraban.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna berkonflik dengan teman. Berikan panduan komunikasi asertif (I-Statement) dan bantu uraikan kesalahpahaman tanpa menyalahkan.
suggested_chips: Lagi ada masalah sama circle
Teman salah paham sama maksudku
Berantem sama sahabat terdekat
Suasana circle jadi canggung banget
topics.sample_question: Hi, I feel scared and like a loser because lately I've had a lot of conflict with my friends. We used to be very close, but now it feels like we're drifting apart and arguing about everything.
topics.sample_answer: Friendship conflicts feel especially hurtful because friends are our chosen support network. Taking time to step back from the heat and communicate honestly using 'I feel' statements can help bridge the gap.
topics.keywords: friend, circle, sahabat, konflik pertemanan, berantem sahabat, salah paham, ketegangan circle

topics.name: Fenomena Silent Treatment & Perang Dingin Antar Teman
topics.description: Didiamkan tanpa kejelasan, pesan WhatsApp hanya dibaca (read only), atau dijauhi secara mendadak tanpa diberi tahu kesalahannya.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna menjadi korban silent treatment. Kuatkan harga diri mereka dan anjurkan komunikasi klarifikasi terbuka satu kali tanpa mengemis.
suggested_chips: Teman-teman pada silent treatment
Didiemin tanpa tahu salahku apa
Chat cuma di-read doang sama sahabat
Perang dingin bikin suasana canggung
topics.sample_question: My best friend suddenly stopped talking to me, leaving my messages on read and avoiding eye contact on campus. The silent treatment is driving me crazy with anxiety.
topics.sample_answer: Silent treatment is an emotionally immature way of handling conflict that creates immense anxiety. You deserve clear communication. Send one calm invitation to talk, and don't beg.
topics.keywords: silent treatment, didiamkan teman, perang dingin, di-read doang, dijauhi tiba-tiba, teman dingin

topics.name: Merasa Ditinggalkan & Dikeluarkan dari Circle (Left Out / Excluded)
topics.description: Mengetahui teman-teman satu circle membuat grup chat baru tanpa dirinya atau pergi berkumpul bersama secara diam-diam.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa disingkirkan dari kelompok. Berikan ruang aman untuk berduka dan bantu mereka melihat bahwa kelompok tersebut mungkin bukan lingkungan yang tepat.
suggested_chips: Circle bikin grup baru tanpa aku
Ngerasa ditinggalkan dan dikucilkan
Mereka nongkrong diam-diam di belakangku
Merasa nggak dianggap di pertemanan
topics.sample_question: I discovered my circle created another group chat without me and went on a weekend trip together. Finding out that I was deliberately excluded broke my heart.
topics.sample_answer: Being intentionally excluded by people you trusted is excruciatingly painful. It speaks about their lack of emotional maturity, not your worthiness of true friendship. Let's process this hurt.
topics.keywords: left out, excluded, dikucilkan, ditinggalkan teman, grup rahasia, circle toksik, tidak dianggap

topics.name: FOMO & Terpaksa Mengikuti Gaya Hidup Mewah Circle
topics.description: Kecemasan tertinggal tren nongkrong di kafe mahal, pakaian bermerek, atau memaksakan diri agar tetap diterima dan tidak ditinggalkan kelompok.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami FOMO dan peer pressure finansial. Kuatkan penerimaan diri dan nilai keaslian personal daripada memaksakan validasi eksternal.
suggested_chips: Takut ketinggalan tren nongkrong
Maksa ikut padahal kantong tipis
Takut dijauhi kalau nggak sefrekuensi
FOMO liat instastory circle
topics.sample_question: I constantly feel peer pressure to conform to what my peers are doing, spending money I don't have on expensive cafes just to fit in. I'm terrified they'll cut me out if I don't join them.
topics.sample_answer: True connection does not require you to sacrifice your financial or emotional safety. Relationships that demand you pretend to be someone else are draining rather than fulfilling.
topics.keywords: fomo, peer pressure, nongkrong mahal, gaya hidup, circle kampus, fit in, standar teman, diterima

topics.name: Menyadari Hubungan Pertemanan yang Berat Sebelah (One-Sided Friendship)
topics.description: Merasa selalu menjadi pihak yang mendengarkan, membantu, dan menginisiasi pertemuan, sementara teman tersebut tidak pernah ada saat dibutuhkan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna berada dalam pertemanan sepihak. Ajak mereka mengevaluasi timbal balik relasi dan menetapkan batasan energi pertemanan.
suggested_chips: Pertemanan rasanya cuma searah
Selalu aku yang nyariin duluan
Dia cuma datang pas ada maunya doang
Capek jadi tempat curhat tapi nggak didengar
topics.sample_question: I realized our friendship is completely one-sided. I always listen to their crises for hours, but when I needed support yesterday, they dismissed me in two sentences.
topics.sample_answer: When a friendship only flows in one direction, you become an unpaid therapist rather than a mutual friend. It's completely reasonable to step back and conserve your emotional energy.
topics.keywords: one sided friendship, pertemanan sepihak, berat sebelah, dimanfaatkan teman, teman toksik

topics.name: Kesulitan Menjaga Pertemanan Lama Setelah Masuk Lingkungan Baru
topics.description: Rasa kehilangan dan kesedihan saat sahabat masa SMA/kampus mulai sibuk sendiri-sendiri dan frekuensi obrolan merenggang drastis.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna sedih hubungan pertemanan lama menjauh. Normalisasikan bahwa pergeseran dinamika pertemanan adalah bagian alami dari proses kedewasaan.
suggested_chips: Sahabat lama sekarang pada sibuk sendiri
Hubungan sama teman SMA makin renggang
Kangen masa-masa dulu bareng sahabat

topics.sample_question: Whenever I try to talk to my mother about my anxiety or burnout, she brushes it off saying I just need to pray harder and stop being lazy. The generational gap is unbridgeable.
